visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white crop top and oversized denim shorts, carries large shopping bags into a modern kitchen with dark brown cabinetry. (2) Close-up shots show hands opening boxes of Mini Oreo and scattering blue snack bags across a white countertop. (3) The woman stands in the kitchen gesturing towards an array of snacks including Lay's chips, Pocky sticks, and a large blue Stitch plush toy. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing her hands using clear tape and wooden sticks to secure snack bags into a structural arrangement. (5) She layered pink and light blue translucent wrapping paper around the snacks to form a massive bouquet. (6) The woman carries the completed, oversized bouquet through a concrete indoor parking garage towards a car. (7) The scene shifts to a school auditorium where several children in black and red graduation gowns stand on stage during a ceremony. (8) In a crowded hall, the woman presents the Stitch bouquet to a young boy in a yellow shirt who smiles excitedly. (9) The family, including a man in a blue shirt and a girl in a white dress, pose for photos in the auditorium with red seats.
